facts.fact: 七岁的 Cinnamon 深夜跟着妈妈站在一辆破拖车屋外，困倦地拉妈妈的衣角。
facts.anchor: We are outside a dilapidated trailer, it’s the middle of the night, and I’m sleepy.

facts.fact: 妈妈向开门的 Herb 抱怨他给的货没感觉，把塑料袋砸回他胸口。
facts.anchor: “You gave me bullshit. It didn’t feel like anything.”

facts.fact: Herb 让母女俩进屋，说他有新货，屋里除了他们没有别人。
facts.anchor: “Fuck, fine, get inside. I got some new shit.”

facts.fact: 十来岁的少年 Orzo 报上名字，让 Cinnamon 睡他的床，自己出去守着。
facts.anchor: Orzo. Get some sleep Cinnamon, I’ll wake you up when it’s time to go.

facts.fact: Orzo 把一只紫条纹青蛙玩偶塞给 Cinnamon，说它是别人给他保平安的，也会保她。
facts.anchor: It was given to me to keep me safe and it will do the same for you.

facts.fact: Cinnamon 被喊声惊醒：门外的人喊血从他们眼睛里漏出来、是绿色的，三个人都死了。
facts.anchor: “Blood is leaking out their fucking eyes! It’s green!”

facts.fact: 推门进来的不是 Orzo 而是一名女警，她把 Cinnamon 抱起来问她好不好。
facts.anchor: Except it isn’t Orzo who is in the room with me.

facts.fact: Cinnamon 问妈妈和 Orzo 在哪，女警眼眶发湿，只说一切没事、她来照顾她。
